description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning)

Benefit: While you have a summoning spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you may mark objects with a range of touch as a standard action, and later summon the marked object to your hand as a free action, as long as it is within 1 mile. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting summoning spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning)
